r.문화권·종교: Belarusian and Russian · mostly Eastern Orthodox
r.경제 체제: State-dominated economy · potash fertilizer, tractors, dependence on Russia
r.주식시장 시가총액: $5.5 billion, 6% of GDP (2025, listed domestic companies)
r.생활 물가 수준: 28% of the US level (2025, World Bank, household consumption at purchasing power parity against the market exchange rate)
r.한국이 파는 것: Machinery, computers 28%, Cars 14%, Other precision and medical instruments 10%, Cosmetics 7% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Stone, cement goods 45%, Other wood 19%, Art, antiques 16%, Sawn timber 8% (2025, share of value)
r.여행경보: Parts of the country: Travel ban · Rest of the country: Leave now
r.정치 구도: The same president has ruled since 1994 and harshly crushed mass protests after the 2020 election.

t.why: Russia's closest ally; it let its territory be used for the 2022 invasion of Ukraine.
t.rel: Russia's closest ally, bound to it in a 'Union State'. It let its territory be used for Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine, and Russian tactical nuclear weapons have been deployed there.
t.know: It has Bialowieza Forest, one of Europe's last primeval forests.
t.etext: The state still runs many Soviet-era factories. It sells potash fertilizer, tractors, heavy trucks and refined petroleum. It depends heavily on cheap Russian energy and the Russian market and is under Western sanctions.
